items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He went to California with Ari. Yeah, Alfred William. Yeah, I know he did.

ctx.x: Alfred Williams. Oh no. I used to play with Alfred William. He's there. He went away there a long time. Somebody in Texas. But he come back there. He's been there ever since. I used to play with my band too. Let me see who we was playing with when he used to play with us. Sam Morgan, I bet you anything. We had a regular band. He played with Sam Morgan a long time. Sam Morgan. No, he wasn't with us when he was there. He left. He went away. Because we had Alfred Martin with us when I got in the band.
He went to California with Ari. Yeah, Alfred William. Yeah, I know he did. Let's see. Oh, bass player. You didn't tell us about the bass player.

So you didn't tell him about the bass player yet? With Sam Morgan. With Sam Morgan. Oh, that was Eddie Gilmore. Keybar, I recall. He came with Sam. Who until Sam got sick? And I did too, you know. Oh, yeah. I know what I'm going to say. Ask me if you played. We always worked together, me and T-Boy, you know. Bass and the bass stick together. You know, at a saxophone player, he used to stick too. We wouldn't be doing nothing. We'd always get a band and take your little jobs, you know, like that, and keep us up.
